scripts.cdk:synth:dev: set -a && . ./.env.deploy.dev && set +a && cd infra && cdk synth -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:synth:prod: set -a && . ./.env.deploy.prod && set +a && cd infra && cdk synth -c environment=prod
scripts.cdk:deploy:dev: set -a && . ./.env.deploy.dev && set +a && SHARP_VERSION=0.35.0 npx @opennextjs/aws build && cp ../handloom-admin/infra/configs/otel-collector.yaml .open-next/server-functions/default/otel.yaml && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=dev && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name HomechromeStoreStack-dev --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.cdk:deploy:prod: set -a && . ./.env.deploy.prod && set +a && SHARP_VERSION=0.35.0 npx @opennextjs/aws build && cp ../handloom-admin/infra/configs/otel-collector.yaml .open-next/server-functions/default/otel.yaml && cd infra && cdk deploy --all --require-approval never -c environment=prod && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id $(aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name HomechromeStoreStack-prod --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='DistributionId'].OutputValue" --output text) --paths '/*'
scripts.cdk:destroy:dev: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk destroy --all -c environment=dev
scripts.cdk:destroy:prod: export AWS_REGION=ap-south-1 && cd infra && cdk destroy --all -c environment=prod
